projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Manage project types, projects, and stage workflows
projects.tab.intro: Projects organize conversations into stages with custom workflows.
projects.form.name: Name *
projects.form.defaultConnectionHint: Used when an Odoo tool is called without a connection id. This is the project’s instance database.
projects.form.ticketConnectionHint: Used by task and ticket tools. May be a different Odoo instance from the default.
projects.form.wikiHint: Off by default. Only this project’s wiki is written, and only for the kinds you turn on. The catch-all General project never receives pages.
projects.form.promptPh: System prompt for conversations in this project…
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create a project to start organizing conversations.
projects.types.intro: Templates with prompts and settings for new projects.
projects.types.promptPh: System prompt for conversations in projects of this type…
projects.types.empty: No project types yet. Create one to get started.
projects.stages.intro: Global workflow stages used by all projects. Drag to reorder.
projects.stages.name: Name
projects.stages.autoAssignTitle: Cards entering this stage are handed to this agent and run autonomously
projects.stages.botTitle: Bot Listen — AI monitors this stage
projects.stages.empty: No stages yet. Add your first stage to define the workflow.
projects.form.codeSourcesHint: Pinned on every new conversation in this project (and when the conversation’s project is set to this one). Multi-select Odoo versions / codebases.
projects.form.workingDirsHint: Where conversations in this project read and write files. First path is the primary working directory. New conversations inherit this list. Optional: without folders, each conversation works in its own EYAS workspace.
projects.form.workingDirsSeedHint: No folder set: each conversation in this project works in its own EYAS workspace. Add a directory to let them work in a shared folder.
projects.types.workingDirsHint: Default folders for new projects of this type. First path is the primary working directory. A project with its own list overrides this.
projects.form.designsHint: New conversations created in this project start with these attached. Changing them later does not touch conversations that already exist.
projects.form.designsAfterSave: Save the project first, then designs can be attached to it.
projects.form.promptInheritHint: Leave empty to inherit the type brief. Start with + to extend it. Anything else replaces the type brief.
projects.types.seed.general.name: General
projects.types.seed.general.description: Everyday conversations that do not belong to a dedicated project.
projects.types.seed.eyas.name: EYAS
projects.types.seed.eyas.description: Internal work on this EYAS instance — agents, skills, prompts, and maintenance.
projects.types.seed.odoo.name: Odoo
projects.types.seed.odoo.description: Source-backed ERP implementation. Create one project per codebase or deployment; type-wide rules stay on this type.
projects.folders.error.home: {{path}} was refused: it is the filesystem root, your home folder or a folder above it. From there a model could reach other tools' memory and your credentials. Choose a project folder inside your home instead.
projects.folders.error.providerHome: {{path}} was refused: it belongs to another AI tool's own storage (its settings, sessions and memory) or to a CLI sign-in folder that EYAS keeps for a provider. Models in EYAS may not work there.
projects.folders.error.vault: {{path}} was refused: it is inside a notes vault or a memory folder (an Obsidian vault, an ai-memory folder or a path listed in security.foreignMemoryPaths). EYAS reads and writes memory only in its own store.
projects.folders.error.eyasData: {{path}} was refused: it is inside EYAS's own data folder (memory, database, keys). There, only a conversation's own workspace can be used as a folder.
projects.folders.error.sensitive: {{path}} was refused: it touches a sensitive location (SSH keys, .env files, the master key or the database).
projects.folders.error.containsEyasData: {{path}} was refused: it is or contains EYAS's own home, data folder or conversation workspaces ({{found}}) — memory, database, keys and logs. A model working there could read them without asking. Choose a folder that does not contain it.
projects.folders.error.containsProviderH: {{path}} was refused: it contains another AI tool's own storage (its settings, sessions and memory) or a CLI sign-in folder that EYAS keeps for a provider ({{found}}). A model working there could read it without asking. Choose a narrower folder that does not contain it.
projects.folders.error.containsVault: {{path}} was refused: it contains a notes vault or a memory folder ({{found}}) — an Obsidian vault, an ai-memory folder or a path listed in security.foreignMemoryPaths. A model working there could read it without asking; EYAS reads and writes memory only in its own store. Choose a narrower folder that does not contain it.
projects.folders.error.notAbsolute: {{path}} was refused: it is not an absolute path. Enter the full path, starting with / (or with a drive letter on Windows).
projects.folders.error.notFound: {{path}} was refused: the folder does not exist or cannot be read.
projects.folders.error.notDirectory: {{path}} was refused: it is a file, not a folder.
